texts: Asymmetric valve prolapse makes a patient unsuitable for valve-sparing root replacement: B.
The operation relies on leaflets that will coapt well once the root is rebuilt; marked, uneven prolapse or damaged cusps make a durable repair unlikely.
Acute dissection, a small annulus, a bicuspid valve with good cusps and concomitant mitral repair do not by themselves rule it out.
In the picture, David keeps the orca's own mouth for the others but turns away the one with a billowing sail.
Memory hook: David keeps every mouth except the one with a sail.
